Weakly supervised changepoint detection learner

Source: R/LearnerCpt.R
LearnerCpt.Rd

This learner is the base class for all weakly supervised changepoint detection learners. Do not use this class directly, but rather inherit from it when implementing specific algorithms. It inherits from mlr3::Learner and sets the task_type to "changepoint". Calling $train() or $predict() on this base class raises an error.

See also

Other Learner: mlr_learners_changepoint.intregrcv, mlr_learners_changepoint.mmif, mlr_learners_changepoint.mmit, mlr_learners_changepoint.xgboost.aft

Method new()

Creates a new instance of this R6 class.

Usage

LearnerCpt$new(
  id,
  param_set = ps(),
  predict_types = "response",
  feature_types = character(),
  properties = character(),
  packages = character(),
  label = NA_character_,
  man = NA_character_
)

Arguments

id

(character(1))
Identifier for the learner.

param_set

(paradox::ParamSet)
Set of hyperparameters.

predict_types

(character())
Supported predict types. A subset of mlr_reflections$learner_predict_types.

feature_types

(character())
Feature types the learner can operate on. A subset of mlr_reflections$task_feature_types.

properties

(character())
Set of learner properties. A subset of mlr_reflections$learner_properties. See mlr3::Learner for the standardized properties.

packages

(character())
Set of required packages. Checked for availability when the learner is constructed and loaded on demand before training and prediction.

label

(character(1))
Display name for the learner.

man

(character(1))
String of the form [pkg]::[topic] pointing to this object's help page, which can be opened via the $help() method.
